market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month traded near $111 on May 1 (monthly high) before pulling back to ~$102 due to Hormuz closure supply shock. Forecasters (EIA, Goldman) see Q2 strength; range $105-125 cited for May. Already very close to $110 with 30 days remaining and active geopolitical catalyst, but pullbacks suggest volatility. Probability moderately high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Hormuz reopening or OPEC+ supply response.
